reason: Hypothesis B proposes a specific, testable graded-microstructure mechanism that directly addresses the multi-property trade-off by decoupling surface protection from bulk strength, and it builds on prior work on L21-strengthened lightweight HEAs rather than offering a generic oxide-dispersion idea. Hypothesis A relies on a less physically sound in-situ oxidation approach that risks embrittlement and does not convincingly integrate corrosion resistance with strength.
